infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Fitnexx uses your local network to sync directly with your other Fitnexx apps.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Fitnexx uses your location to detect which gym you are at.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Fitnexx uses your location to detect which gym you are at, even while the app is in the background.

plugins.cameraPermission: Fitnexx uses your camera to take food photos and scan barcodes or sync codes.
